title: dspant: Digital Signal Processing for Analysis Toolkit
description:
dspant (Digital Signal Processing for Analysis Toolkit) is a Python package with a Rust core developed by Jesús D. Peñaloza-Aponte and Erica A. Dale for processing electrophysiological time series. It loads recordings lazily with Dask for out-of-core processing and stores data and metadata in an open format based on Parquet and JSON (.ant).

This archival deposit preserves the software, Rust extensions, and reproduction pipelines used in support of the publication:

Penaloza-Aponte JD, Holmes TC, Mickle AR, Harbert RA, Baekey D, Streeter KA, Dale EA. Invasive diaphragm electromyography data acquisition and analysis in rodents. Biomedical Signal Processing and Control (under revision).

Note: This repository is an archival scientific artifact provided strictly "as is" without ongoing maintenance, updates, or technical support.
